meta.derivedFrom: Reins design system (reins, reins-site, zeron) + round 3 direction C
meta.redesign: Reins Signal redesign, Oct 2026. Sans proposed: Instrument Sans (Geist kept as fallback/alternative).

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: The ground of every screen. Cool paper in light, graphite in dark.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, inputs, header buttons, mode tiles, the Android nav bar.

tokens.name: paper-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented wells, steppers, soft buttons, tags, a switch that is off.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, asks on paper, row titles, values (16.8:1 light, 16:1 dark on `paper`).

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Row keys, body copy, values that aren't the point (5.9:1 light, 7.8:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-meta
tokens.usage: Small meta: senders, dates, section labels, hints (4.9:1 light, 5.8:1 dark on `paper`).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Chevrons, unchecked rings, the sheet grabber. Decoration only, never text.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: The hairline under every row and around raised plates.

tokens.name: inverse
tokens.usage: The main button and the floating tab bar: ink turned into a plate.

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs on `inverse` (18:1 light, 16:1 dark).

tokens.name: violet
tokens.usage: Reins violet as text or a glyph on paper: links, Auto tags, Autopilot's voice (5.7:1 light, 7.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: violet-fill
tokens.usage: Violet as a fill: switches that are on, the Auto chip, count badges. White text on it is 6.2:1.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Additions in diffs, Ready, allowed outcomes.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Deletions in diffs, destructive rows, end now, red hold buttons on paper.

tokens.name: danger-wash
tokens.usage: Fill behind a red button on paper (End now, Bypass, Hold to delete).

tokens.name: danger-fill-2
tokens.usage: The progress that fills a hold button as you hold.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text on paper: a flagged code, an expiring item.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind sheets; the field stays visible, dimmed.

tokens.name: field-push
tokens.usage: Field: the AI wants to write or send (push, send email, comment). White text 5.2:1.

tokens.name: field-read
tokens.usage: Field: the AI wants to read or search. White text 5.2:1.

tokens.name: field-delete
tokens.usage: Field: irreversible (delete, force-push, pay) and Bypass. White text 6.5:1.

tokens.name: field-grant
tokens.usage: Field: a grant, power you already handed over. White text 6.2:1.

tokens.name: field-pair
tokens.usage: Field: pair a device or connect an AI. White text 5.4:1.

tokens.name: field-accounts
tokens.usage: Field: account changes (passwords, recovery, sign-in). White text 6.0:1.

tokens.name: field-warn
tokens.usage: Field: something is broken and needs you (notifications off, phone not approving). White text 4.9:1.

tokens.name: on-field
tokens.usage: Text, glyphs and the Review button on any field.

tokens.name: on-field-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a field: label line, device, verdict detail (14px+ only).

tokens.name: on-field-wash
tokens.usage: Translucent buttons and the close button on a field.

tokens.name: rule-2
tokens.usage: Stronger hairline: outline buttons, input borders.

tokens.name: kind-push
tokens.usage: Kind tile ink on paper (tile fill is this at 13%, 14% in dark).

tokens.name: kind-read
tokens.usage: Kind tile ink.

tokens.name: kind-delete
tokens.usage: Kind tile ink.

tokens.name: kind-grant
tokens.usage: Kind tile ink.

tokens.name: kind-pair
tokens.usage: Kind tile ink.

tokens.name: kind-accounts
tokens.usage: Kind tile ink.

tokens.name: kind-warn
tokens.usage: Kind tile ink.

tokens.name: canvas-wall
tokens.usage: Design canvas background only. Not used in the apps.

styles.name: ask
styles.usage: The ask on a field. The target goes in italic.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Big numbers: stats, time left (54px on a grant field).

styles.name: ask-small
styles.usage: The ask on a waiting card.

styles.name: mood
styles.usage: One quiet line under a title: "Two things wait for you."

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Approved without asking. Sent means sent.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: The label line on a field and section labels, set in capitals.

styles.name: value
styles.usage: Branches, accounts, addresses, SHAs, the timer.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Icon to label inside tags.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between buttons in a waiting card; tag gaps.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Label line to ask; ask to verdict on small cards.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Waiting card inset from the screen edge; top bar padding.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: The screen gutter for text, lists and fields.

tokens.name: space-26
tokens.usage: Above section labels.

tokens.name: space-34
tokens.usage: Bottom padding of the decision bar, clear of the home indicator.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Kind tiles (38px); 46px tiles use 14px.

tokens.name: radius-input
tokens.usage: Text inputs and copy fields.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Waiting cards and mode tiles (22px).

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: The bottom corners of a field; the top runs into the screen's own corners.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: The top corners of sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented controls, tags, the tab bar.

tokens.name: shadow-ring
tokens.usage: Outline for raised plates on paper: header buttons, inputs, chips.

tokens.name: shadow-nav
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar, the only thing that floats.

tokens.name: opacity-off
tokens.usage: An email or item you've unchecked.

tokens.name: opacity-nav-idle
tokens.usage: Tab bar items that aren't selected.

tokens.name: hold-duration
tokens.usage: Hold to delete, hold to bypass, keep holding.

tokens.name: field-in
tokens.usage: A field slides down into place when a request opens.

tokens.name: fade
tokens.usage: Colour and hover changes.

tokens.name: fold
tokens.usage: Answered field folds into its kind tile at the top of the list.

tokens.name: card-fly
tokens.usage: Flicked waiting card leaves.

tokens.name: tab-pill
tokens.usage: Tab pill spring, cubic-bezier(0.3, 1.25, ...) slight overshoot.

tokens.name: sheet-rise
tokens.usage: Sheet spring over a 32% scrim.

tokens.name: drill-in
tokens.usage: Pushed page.

tokens.name: menu-open
tokens.usage: Menu grows from its trigger, scale 0.92 to 1. Closes in 120ms.

tokens.name: hold-drain
tokens.usage: Released hold drains, no haptic.

grain.usage: Only on colour fields (decision surfaces). Never on paper, text or glyphs. Off with Reduce Transparency.
